```{r loading packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, paged.print=FALSE}
    library(haven)
    library(tidyverse)
    library(bootnet)
    library(corclass)
```
```{r multiple imputation}
    mydata <-  read_dta("C:/Users/Omar Lizardo/Google Drive/MISC DATA SOURCES/SSI-2012/SSI2012.dta")
    music.dat <- mydata[,grep("*taste$", names(mydata))]
    music.dat <- select(music.dat, ends_with("taste"))
    music.dat <- music.dat[,c(1:20)]
    music.dat[music.dat == 1] <- 3
    music.dat[music.dat == 2] <- 1
    music.dat[music.dat == 3] <- 2
    music.dat[music.dat == 4] <- NA
    names(music.dat) <- c("Classical", "Opera", "Jazz", "Broadway", "Easy", "Big Band", "Oldies", "Country",
                   "Blueg.", "Folk", "Gospel", "Latin", "Rap", "Blues", "Reggae", 
                   "Pop", "Rock", "Alt", "Dance", "Metal")
    head(music.dat)
```

```{r getting and recoding data}
    taste.dat <-  read_dta("C:/Users/Omar Lizardo/Google Drive/WORK/IN PROGRESS/CULTURE/lizardo-taste-schemas/dta/taste.dta")
    taste.dat <- select(taste.dat, 1:21)
    head(taste.dat)
    lis.dat <-  read_dta("C:/Users/Omar Lizardo/Google Drive/MISC DATA SOURCES/SSI-2012/SSI2012.dta")
    lis.dat <- select(lis.dat, "id", ends_with("lis"), -(starts_with("none")))
    names(lis.dat) <- c("id", "Classical", "Opera", "Jazz", "Broadway", "Easy", "Big Band", "Oldies", "Country",
                   "Blueg.", "Folk", "Gospel", "Latin", "Rap", "Blues", "Reggae", 
                   "Pop", "Rock", "Alt", "Dance", "Metal")
                   
    names(lis.dat)
```


                   
                   
```{r correlational class analysis}
    cca.res <- cca(taste.dat[, c(2:21)], filter.value = 0.01)
    taste.dat <- data.frame(taste.dat, cca.res$membership)
    names(taste.dat[,length(taste.dat)]) <- "classmem"
    colnames(taste.dat)[colnames(taste.dat) == "cca.res.membership"] <- "classmem"
```




```{r correlation plots}
    for (i in 1:5) {
      x <- subset(taste.dat, classmem == i)[,c(2:21)]
      windows(height = 14, width = 14)
      qgraph(cor_auto(x), layout = "spring", 
             labels = names(lis.dat), repulsion = 1.5,
             graph = "cor", sampleSize = nrow(x), 
             alpha = 0.01, minimum = 0.05, threshold = "sig",
             groups = gen.groups, palette = "colorblind", 
             legend = FALSE, esize = 15, 
             posCol = "darkgray", borders = FALSE)
      savePlot(filename = paste("C:/Users/Omar Lizardo/Google Drive/WORK/IN PROGRESS/CULTURE/lizardo-taste-schemas/png/taste-corrnet-class", 
                                i, sep = ""), type = "png")
      }
```

```{r expected influence plot}
    library(networktools)
    library(gridExtra)
    library(grid)
    plot.dat <- filter(taste.dat, classmem == 1)
    out1 <- expectedInf(cor_auto(plot.dat[,2:21]))
    p1 <- plot(out1$step1, order="value", zscore=TRUE) + labs(title = "Anything (but Country)") + theme_minimal()
    plot.dat <- filter(taste.dat, classmem == 2)
    out1 <- expectedInf(cor_auto(plot.dat[,2:21]))
    p2 <- plot(out1$step1, order="value", zscore=TRUE) + labs(title = "Anything (but Heavy Metal)") + theme_minimal()
    plot.dat <- filter(taste.dat, classmem == 3)
    out1 <- expectedInf(cor_auto(plot.dat[,2:21]))
    p3 <- plot(out1$step1, order="value", zscore=TRUE) + labs(title = "Contemporary/Traditional") + theme_minimal()
    plot.dat <- filter(taste.dat, classmem == 4)
    out1 <- expectedInf(cor_auto(plot.dat[,2:21]))
    p4 <- plot(out1$step1, order="value", zscore=TRUE) + labs(title = "Omnivore/Univore") + theme_minimal()
    plot.dat <- filter(taste.dat, classmem == 5)
    out1 <- expectedInf(cor_auto(plot.dat[,2:21]))
    p5 <- plot(out1$step1, order="value", zscore=TRUE) + labs(title = "Contempo/Folksy/Easy") + theme_minimal()
    windows(height = 5, width = 14)
    grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, ncol = 5)
    savePlot(filename = "C:/Users/Omar Lizardo/Google Drive/WORK/IN PROGRESS/CULTURE/lizardo-taste-schemas/png/taste-centrality-class.png",
             type = "png")
```







```{r}
    lis.classmem <- merge(lis.dat, taste.dat[, c(1, length(taste.dat))], by = "id")
    lis.classmem <- lis.classmem %>%  
                    mutate(omni = rowSums(lis.classmem[2:21])) %>%  
                    mutate(omnicat = 
                             recode(omni, `0` = 1, `2` = 1, `3` = 2, `4` = 2, `5` = 3, `6` = 3, `7` = 4, `8` = 4, `9` = 5,
                                    `10` = 5, `11` = 5, `12` = 5, `13` = 5, `14` = 5, `15` = 5, `16` = 5, `17` = 5,
                                    `18` = 5, `19` = 5, `20` = 5
                                    )
                    ) %>%
                    select(-c("id"))
                    group_by(lis.classmem, classmem, omnicat)
    
    #lis.classmem <- mutate(lis.classmem, omni = rowSums(lis.classmem[2:21]))
    #lis.classmem <- mutate(lis.classmem, omnicat = 
                             #recode(omni, `0` = 1, `2` = 1, `3` = 2, `4` = 2, `5` = 3, `6` = 3, `7` = 4, `8` = 4, `9` = 5,
                                   # `10` = 5, `11` = 5, `12` = 5, `13` = 5, `14` = 5, `15` = 5, `16` = 5, `17` = 5,

                                   # )

    lis.classmem <- select(lis.classmem, -c("id"))
    lis.classmem <- group_by(lis.classmem, classmem, omnicat)
    lis.classmem <- summarize(lis.classmem, count = n())
```
